narrative: Both are from Colorado. The 2-headed monster. They felt the league was too complex for just 1 owner so they joined forces to run their team. They were with us from the beginning until 2010. They made it to the Super Bowl in their final season but lost by posting our lowest score ever in a Championship game. No other records are held but they did walk away with some Awards and a division champ. 1 Defensive Rookie of the Year (TJ Ward) and 2 Manager of the Year for seasons 4 and 5. This team was no slouch. They were with us for 5 seasons and made the Playoffs in 4 of them. Finishing 3-4 in the Playoffs and 57-38 in the regular season.
